treatment.request: An animated README cover for LitHermes that shows a working system.
treatment.idea: Dots lap three rings, flash a gate at twelve o'clock and light a ledger that empties as the loop returns.
treatment.recipeReason: A system with crossings reads as work being checked, beside a still name.

motto.from: the motto painted on the repository artwork

layers.slow: Dashed ring shadows turn a quarter lap per loop.
layers.mid: Dots lap at three, two and one laps per loop and the core breathes once.
layers.beat: Gates flash on each crossing, the core rings on four bars, ledger cells light.

system.rule: One orbit rule with integer laps per loop.
system.copies: Eight dots on three rings and sixteen ledger cells.
system.offset: Each dot's start angle and its ring's lap count.

treatment.ambition: Every crossing is visible on the beat and the ledger loops without a reset.
